paragraphs: Subject: List of Candidates Found Eligible for the Written Examination – Post of Staff Nurse
Objection raised by previous Selction Committee

Applications received for the post of Staff Nurse have been scrutinized. Based on the recommendations of the Scrutiny Committee, the eligible candidate’s list has been displayed on the website and notice board. Rest of the candidates are ineligible as per the criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
Staff Nurse Written Exam Eligible Candidate List
If any applicant is not satisfied, they may submit a written representation along with supporting documents. Representations without valid supporting documents will not be entertained.
Please contact the Medical Superintendent’s Office (Personnel Section) on or before 16 th June 2025, by 5:00 PM.
Note: No requests will be entertained after the specified deadline.

Candidates who qualify the Written Examination will be shortlisted for the Skill Test and those who will qualify Skill test will be called for the Interview on the same day. The list of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on the Notice Board of Kasturba Hospital, Sewagram & Website.
Written Examination, Skill Test Interview & Schedule:
Central Examination Hall, Kasturba Hospital, Sewagram
Committee room, Medical Superintendent Office, Kasturba Hospital, Sewagram
